title: Has anyone been able to purchase or remove any items from the bookstore?
content: Bought a few books at the bookshop in the mall last night then spent the rest of the dream looking for them. I swear you can’t take anything out of that store, it will have some of your favorite items but they’re all anchored to that area and can’t leave. Then at the end of the dream it was complete chaos, a militia was going down the street In repurposed military vehicles, some “gravy seal” looking guy was telling people to remain calm over megaphone while riding in a tank. People were not remaining calm, I woke up when all the guns came out. Mall World was nutty last night.
